Contact us today to schedule your project — we’re here to help you cross every task off your list.

about:
At Einstein Plumbing, we specialize in expert water heater installations designed to bring comfort, reliability, and efficiency to your home or business. Whether you’re replacing an outdated tank or upgrading to the latest tankless model, our licensed Chicago plumbers deliver top-quality workmanship and fast, dependable service.
Tankless water heaters are the future of home comfort—providing endless hot water, lower energy bills, and space-saving convenience. Unlike traditional tanks that constantly heat water, tankless systems heat on demand, giving you hot water exactly when you need it while using less energy. We work with leading brands to ensure our customers get durable, high-performance systems that last.
Our team handles everything from removal and disposal of old units to professional installation and safety testing of your new system. We take pride in clean, efficient, and code-compliant installs—done right the first time.
Whether you’re ready for a full upgrade or simply exploring your options, Einstein Plumbing is here to help you find the perfect fit for your home and budget. Experience the convenience of tankless hot water today!
